senses.definition_en: Used to express annoyance or dismissive reproach at someone’s repeated insistence on a topic, option, or behavior, conveying the idea of “enough with that” or “here you go again with the same thing.”
senses.definition_es: Se usa para expresar fastidio, reproche o desestimación ante la insistencia en un tema, opción o actitud, con el sentido de “basta con eso” o “otra vez con lo mismo”.

examples.en:
“Make me a pastafrola. Come on.”
“Yeah?”
“But quince jelly, okay?”
“No, not quince. Sweet potato…”
“`Enough with` the sweet potato `already`.”
“I’ll make it for you.”
“Alright. Go on, go on.”
examples.es:
—Haceme una pastafrola. Dale.
—¿Sí?
—Pero de membrillo, mami, eh.
—No. De membrillo, no. De batata...
—`Dale con` la batata.
—Te hago.
—Bueh. Dale, dale, dale.
